title: The Grateful Dead Live at Field House, U. of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03
source: SBD MR>R>FLAC; Monitor Noise throughout show; tranfer Matt Smith 7/2011

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic ’70 show featuring a magical acoustic Wake Up Little Susie and fan‑favorite Cosmic Charlie.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this 1970 performance, calling it one of the year’s best recordings. Highlights include Jerry and Bob’s unexpected acoustic rendition of “Wake Up Little Susie” and the beloved “Cosmic Charlie,” both praised for their charm. The soundboard source is noted for its clarity, though a lone low‑star rating adds a note of mixed sentiment.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for both the musical performance and soundboard quality outweighs the single contradictory low star, yielding an overall high rating with moderate confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the best recordings of 1970; clear and well‑balanced sound with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic interlude with Jerry and Bob adds a unique, memorable moment early in the show, contributing to an overall engaging flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his acoustic performance alongside Bob, wearing matching jeans and white tees.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for his vocal and guitar work during the acoustic “Wake Up Little Susie” segment.
